what_differs: WAGR-213 (Jumpr Review) and WAGR-107 (Ready) hold single deal fields: Redeposit Required, Redeposit Type and one Immediate range. On 2026-09-30 the client decided redeposit requirements change over a deal's life with their own effective dates, and a deal can have first and secondary immediate requirements with different thresholds (80%/90% and 50%) that must be reportable. WAGR-462 covers dated history of 'redeposit required' but no ticket covers multiple requirements or thresholds.
suggested_action: Suggestion: hold WAGR-213 and WAGR-107 before release; fold redeposit requirements into the WAGR-462 dated-terms design (or a child object) with threshold fields, then repurpose or close WAGR-107/213 as WAGR-464's 'Done when' requires.
